entries.53fb17d691bb7773: The company lists customer-first, coexistence and co-prosperity, human resource development, and creative pioneering as its management principles, and states that it practices "the provision of one-stop services for real estate and receivables" as its business model. In the servicer business, the company states that it works to improve its receivables due diligence capabilities and its ability to present prices based on future cash flows expected to be recovered, and that it works to secure opportunities to purchase receivables, mainly from megabanks and regional financial institutions. It also states that it will focus on areas where it can use its own know-how and its network of specialists from the perspective of business revitalization, for rescheduled and problem receivables that financial institutions continue to hold.

entries.755e7774dc4886ea: As a debt collection company licensed by the Minister of Justice under the Act on Special Measures Concerning Debt Collection Business (the Servicer Act), this business purchases or accepts entrustment of specified monetary claims from financial institutions and other entities, and conducts valuation (due diligence), management and collection of the claims. As a sideline business, it also provides consulting on business turnaround, individual rehabilitation, business succession, business closure support, debt restructuring and similar matters, due diligence on real estate and claims, and brokerage for the sale and purchase of specified monetary claims. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥727 million.
